080003BC-080003C4 loads the shared table and reads a halfword at twice the edge-height index; the sibling rasterizers share the base. All 1024 positive-index entries exactly equal the nearest integer to 32768/index; the zero sentinel and first nonmatching following halfword are checked. The following alignment halfword is excluded.
